$comment: Copy to config/sosie.local.json (gitignored) and fill in this machine's paths. Keys left out of the local file keep these defaults.

ports.$comment: web = Vite dev server, api = Sosie API, comfy = Sosie's own ComfyUI. Never 8188 (the main ComfyUI).

paths.$comment: Absolute paths on this machine. Empty = not configured; the System panel lists what is missing.

gpus.$comment: Physical indices (CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID). H3 is split across four cards; image and TTS pick from the list by free memory.

loras.$comment: LoRA file names (from the model store's loras/ folder) offered in the character creator.
